skill.name: agy-worker
skill.description: Use when Codex or Claude Code should delegate repository exploration or implementation to Google Antigravity CLI (agy), then review, verify, repair, and deliver the result.
skill.summary: Delegate bounded repository work to Google Antigravity CLI, then review candidate changes and record independent verification.
skill.author: cagdasyurekli

security_audit.summary: Most supplied matches are benign documentation, validation checks, or controlled runtime plumbing; verifier execution and broader isolation grants remain security risks. Session execution retains host authority, while native mode permits non-local TCP 443 and broad Keychain service access. No malicious intent was found; 296 omitted static matches remain unadjudicated and require manual review before automatic publication. Static review was capped at 400/696 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 296 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Driver verifiers execute untrusted candidate code without OS confinement.
remediation.suggestion: Offer enforced isolated verification with no credentials, denied network access, and writable disposable copies before accepting candidate results.

remediation.issue: Session staging does not restrict ambient host authority or enabled hooks and plugins.
remediation.suggestion: Use supported native containment or a dedicated isolated account; retain explicit approval and prohibit automatic fallback to session execution.

remediation.issue: Native TCP 443 and listener permissions do not enforce approved provider destinations.
remediation.suggestion: Use a recipient-restricted egress proxy and remove listener permissions where unnecessary; test blocked destinations and wildcard binds.

remediation.issue: Native Keychain service access lacks item-level or helper-operation restrictions.
remediation.suggestion: Broker only required authentication operations outside the worker boundary; use a dedicated account and test unrelated Keychain access denial.

remediation.issue: The supplied static catalog omits 296 repeated or lower-priority matches.
remediation.suggestion: Review the omitted matches before automatic publication and retain their per-location adjudication evidence.

semantic_findings.title: Session Scoping Does Not Confine Host Authority
semantic_findings.description: Session mode retains ambient HOME, filesystem access, network access, plugins, hooks, and MCP servers. A compromised worker or enabled hook can access unrelated host data despite approved content staging.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The security guide explicitly states that selected staging cannot prevent host access in session mode. The launch path supplies native containment only when explicitly selected.

semantic_findings.title: Native Network Grant Is Not Recipient-Restricted
semantic_findings.description: Native mode permits the provider image to contact non-local TCP port 443 destinations without a Google recipient allowlist or enforced TLS. A compromised provider could transmit staged content elsewhere; baseline listener grants can also permit wildcard binds.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The rendered profile allows remote TCP *:443 and the guide explicitly disclaims recipient restrictions and TLS enforcement. This is documented residual authority, not evidence of observed exfiltration.

semantic_findings.title: Native Keychain Services Exceed Item-Level Authorization
semantic_findings.description: The dedicated-Keychain file binding does not restrict security-helper arguments or system Keychain service operations. Broader same-user credential reads or modifications may remain possible where macOS permissions allow them.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The profile grants system Keychain services to the provider or exact security helper. The guide explicitly acknowledges operation-level limits; broader credential access was not demonstrated during this review.

content.user_title: Delegate Repository Tasks and Verify Changes
content.value_statement: Delegated repository changes need clear data boundaries and independent checks. agy-worker coordinates approved Antigravity tasks, candidate review, bounded repairs, and evidence-based finalization.
actual_capabilities: Preview provider-readable content and bind approval to task details, model choices, content digests, isolation, and budgets.
Run explore, task, and project workflows through a bundled lifecycle facade.
Stage selected read paths and reconcile changes only within an approved write subset.
Track job status, preserve eligible candidates, and support approved recovery or same-conversation repairs.
Validate worker reports, compare candidate state, and record driver-owned verification receipts.
Offer explicit macOS native containment for supported scoped provider launches and advisory self-verification.
limitations: Requires Bash, Python 3, Git, and an authenticated Antigravity CLI with provider network access.
Session mode retains user filesystem access, network authority, and enabled ambient hooks or plugins.
Native containment requires supported macOS conditions and a dedicated Keychain; network recipients and Keychain operations remain incompletely restricted.
Driver verification requires independent judgment; candidate checks can execute untrusted code, and local evidence receipts are unsigned.

use_cases.title: Add Focused Regression Tests
use_cases.description: Delegate selected source inspection and test edits, then independently review the diff and run the existing suite.

use_cases.title: Explore an Unfamiliar Repository
use_cases.description: Request bounded architecture findings from approved paths, then spot-check claims before planning implementation.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Bounded Project Repairs
use_cases.description: Track delegated fixes, preserve partial candidates, and record build, test, and lint evidence before finalization.

prompt_templates.title: Check Local Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agy-worker to check offline readiness for [repository]. Report missing prerequisites. Do not launch a provider or change account settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect prerequisites without transmitting repository content.

prompt_templates.title: Preview Scoped Exploration
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an explore preview for [repository] using only [read paths]. Show the exact task, content boundary, model, isolation, and budget for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review a bounded provider launch before authorizing it.

prompt_templates.title: Delegate a Test Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a task to add [regression tests] using [read paths], with writes limited to [test paths]. Request launch approval, then review and verify independently.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: delegate implementation while retaining driver acceptance.

prompt_templates.title: Repair and Finalize a Candidate
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [job ID] and its bound candidate. Use approved same-conversation repair only if eligible and within budget. Finalize with independent evidence and explicit verification gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover useful work without widening scope or bypassing lifecycle checks.

output_examples.input: Check local readiness without starting Antigravity.
output: Required local tools and CLI capabilities are available.
Provider authentication and task success remain unverified.

output_examples.input: Preview a task that adds parser tests without editing application source.
output: Readable scope: selected parser source and tests.
Launch approval pending review of the exact task, digest, model, isolation, and budget.

output_examples.input: Report a candidate whose focused tests passed but whose full build was unavailable.
output: Reviewed changes: regression tests within the approved write scope.
Independent evidence: focused parser suite passed.
Remaining gap: full project build was not run.

best_practices: Prefer narrow read scopes and write subsets; exclude secrets and unrelated private content before approving a launch.
Choose isolation explicitly and review ambient hooks, credential exposure, model settings, and budgets before dispatch.
Inspect the actual diff and run independent checks in an appropriately isolated copy before finalizing candidate assurance.
anti_patterns: Treating installation, a readiness result, or a worker report as approval or proof of correctness.
Assuming staged content, path gates, or session mode prevent access to unrelated host files.
Executing worker-reported commands or silently widening scope, permissions, isolation, or repair budgets after failure.

faq.question: Which assistant hosts are supported?
faq.answer: The package supports OpenAI Codex CLI and Claude Code. It delegates repository work to the separately installed Antigravity CLI.

faq.question: Does installation authorize provider access?
faq.answer: No. Live dispatch requires human approval covering the exact task, readable content, transmission, isolation, model choices, and budget.

faq.question: Can the provider receive only selected files?
faq.answer: Scoped mode stages approved read entries and reconciles only authorized writes. Session mode still retains ambient host authority.

faq.question: Is native isolation available on every platform?
faq.answer: No. Native mode requires supported macOS scoped containment and a dedicated unlocked Keychain. Unsupported conditions fail without automatic session fallback.

faq.question: Does a passing worker report prove the change is correct?
faq.answer: No. The driver must inspect the candidate and run independent checks. Worker command and test claims are not accepted as verification evidence.

faq.question: What happens when a job fails or exhausts its budget?
faq.answer: Inspect status and preserve eligible candidate work. Recovery follows recorded actions and approval requirements; exhausted checks require an explicit report of remaining gaps.
